note: Large family campground near Middle Point (Van Wert Co) known for its summer band showcase and St. Jude fundraising; many seasonal sites, pools and a swimming pond. --Claude
summary: Fees: low $45 confirmed (basic electric-only, on the rate page and on Staylist for a June 2027 weeknight), high raised 60->67 (deluxe patio); standard W/E is now $57 and premium $62 (note said $55/$60). Added 50-amp/water/sewer, Staylist booking link, 365-day window, weekend 2 / holiday 3 minimums, check-in/out. Cleared the RV Life-derived 400-site count. Note: dropped the price, minimum and RV Life text the fields hold. Season left unset: Staylist sold RV sites in November and April but not the basic sites. Gate passes at $45.
flags: Private gate facts: cheapest real RV night $45 (Basic RV-Electric Only, stone or grass, plus tax; Staylist June 16, 2027, a Wednesday) - under $50; the next type up is $57. Google Maps 4.4 stars from 431 reviews, phone (419) 968-2211 matches; Good Sam directory lists it but not as a Good Sam Park (no discount); nearest gateway none within 40 km (Columbus 161 km); presence: operator website live with phone plus a Staylist engine. Passes. The $45 is an ordinary weeknight; event weekends (band showcase, St. Jude) carry the 2-night weekend minimum and 'Holiday rates may apply' on the basic sites.
Website: the stored http://www.huggybearcampground.com/ redirects (301) to https://www.huggybearcampground.com/ - use the https URL.

Long-stay: many seasonal sites, weekly/monthly by phone, but the policy says 'This is a transient guest relationship and not a tenancy or long term housing', and Staylist had 100+ RV sites open for one June weeknight - tests 2 and 4 pass.
